plan.notes: TRUE catalog program name: 'Computer Science, Bachelor of Science (B.S.)', Computer Science (General) Concentration, Department of Computer Science and Information Technology, Eastern Kentucky University. The B.S. in Computer Science is offered with three concentrations (Computer Science (General), Artificial Intelligence in Data Science, Interactive Multimedia); this plan transcribes the official 'Computer Science B.S. - Computer Science (General) Concentration' Plan of Study Grid, the catalog's default/core track. Source: official EKU Academic Catalog page (source_url below), read live on 2026-09-30. CATALOG-YEAR HONESTY: catalog_year 2026-2027 is the CURRENT catalog edition, verified via the catalog homepage ('2026-2027 Academic Catalog'). CREDIT TOTALS: the catalog's program page states Total Hours 120; the plan-of-study grid itself prints per-term ranges (15-16, 17-18) and a grid total of '120-122'. This file uses the MINIMUM of every ranged blank slot (science 3, Y3S1 blank 4), so the plan sums to exactly 120 = total_credits. A student choosing a 4-credit science option (e.g. BIO 111 & 111L) or a 5-credit Y3S1 block lands at 121-122, inside the catalog's own published 120-122 range. BLANK SLOTS: the grid leaves 14 slots as bare hour counts with no course named; they are transcribed as choice:true slots - one 1-credit CSC 494/495/496 senior-experience choice (options named in the catalog), one 3-4 credit Natural Science (Element 2B) choice with the catalog's six official options, and twelve unspecified Essential Education / free-elective slots (the grid does not assign which are which; per the 30-hour Essential Education requirement, ENG 101/102, MAT 234 (Element 2A) and the science choice satisfy ~13-14 of the 30 hours, the rest come from the unspecified slots). Per-term sums with minimums: 16+16+15+15+17+15+13+13 = 120. ADVISORY (not a degree requirement, in notes not external_prereqs): students without a 25 ACT or 590 SAT are advised to take CSC 170 Intro to Game Programming as preparation for CSC 185/CSC 190. Catalog also requires 39 hrs of upper-division (300-level+) courses distributed across categories. Prereq arrays intentionally left empty per seed-file convention; the catalog's plan-of-study grid is the sequence authority. Transcription method: read the official plan-of-study grid course-by-course; titles and credits copied verbatim from the catalog page.
